answer_quote: **Yes.** The peritoneal smear shows an inflammatory (septic) exudate consistent with acute peritonitis: numerous small mononuclear/polyhedral leukocytes (predominantly neutrophils) together with scattered free extracellular bacteria (the pink/magenta rod‑ and coccoid‑shaped forms) in the background.
note: 答复把“单核细胞”与“以中性粒细胞为主”并列，细胞类型表述自相矛盾；图像不足以诊断脓毒性腹膜炎。
